_about: Selection gate thresholds. tau is set per corpus and per teacher so that the same fraction of answer positions passes the gate; the coverage target is the quantity held fixed, not the nats. Where a cell is listed as coverage-calibrated the threshold was solved for at build time from that teacher's own entropy distribution, so its value in nats depends on the teacher and is not a constant of the corpus. These are the settings the selections in data/subsets/ were built with; code/01_build_store/config.json is authoritative.

thresholds.source: the untrained-teacher section of the paper

thresholds.note: different tokenizer and entropy scale from Qwen, so the threshold is recalibrated rather than reused
